text: Magog was an Irish and British hero. The name of a famous Cornish giant also appears in the mythological history of Ireland. In the Book of Invasions, Magog was said to be the ancestor of Partholón and Nemed, two early invaders of Ireland. He was also the ancestor of the Scythians, reputed ancient relatives of the Irish. Whether this Irish figure relates to the Cornish giant Gog is not known.
objective: Document Magog as an Irish and British hero and ancestor of early invaders.
